info.title: n8n Node Contract: the action interface
info.description:
Generated from spec/wit (world action-bundle) by scripts/spec.ts. Do not edit.

An action: it reads items and gives items. The host gives an optional import only to an
action whose manifest needs it: `binary` for a `t.binary()` field, `supplied` for a
`provider.input()` field, the others when the manifest `imports` lists them.

Both sides send requests on one connection. `x-direction` tells which side answers a method. A method without `result` is a notification. Names in brackets are not WIT functions: the JSON-RPC mapping adds them.

methods.name: [initialize]
methods.description: The first message. The host sends the Node Contract version that it implements. The guest answers with the version and the kind of its bundle. The host closes the connection when the bundle version is outside its range or needs a newer minor.

methods.name: action.describe
methods.description: The manifest contract: id, version, flow, credentials, input and output schema.

methods.name: action.migrate
methods.description:
The parameters of a workflow node of the older major `from-major`, changed to the input
of this major. A bundle without `migrate` gives an error. The host answers no import
call during `migrate`. Publish replays the migration fixtures with it.

methods.name: chunk.item
methods.description:
The guest starts the input item at this index of the chunk. The host accepts only the
next index, and fails the run on another index or on a host call before the first item.

methods.name: parsers.extract
methods.description:
The content of `file`. `csv` and `xlsx`: a list of rows. `json`: the value of the file.
`text`: the text as a JSON string. `pdf`: `{ pages, pageCount, info?, metadata? }`, with
the text of each page that the host read. An error when the file is not in the format.

schema.description: A handle of binary.binary. The side that creates the resource numbers it.

errors.message: The error of the WIT result.

methods.name: schema.validate
methods.description:
The issues of `value` against the JSON Schema 2020-12 `schema`, one line each, e.g.
`page.results: must be array`, or none. `path` names the value in the issues. With
`allow-expressions`, a field may hold a `={{ }}` expression, as at build time.

action.item-outcome.description: The result of one input item of a `chunk-run`.

oneOf.description: The one output of the item.

action.item-ref.description: An item of one of the inputs.

input.description: The index of the input: in the manifest `inputs` names, or below the count.

oneOf.description: The input item, passed on unchanged with its binary data.
A new item, made from these input items.
A new item from the current input item of a `per-item` or `1:N` run.
The input item at this index, passed on unchanged with its binary data.
A new item of a `batch` run, made from the input items at these indexes.

to.description: One of the named outputs of the manifest. None when the manifest has none.

bytes.description: The size in bytes. None when the host does not know it.

binary.binary-request.description: An `http-request` without `body`: the binary is the body.

body.description: A handle of binary.binary. The side that creates the resource numbers it.

val.description: A handle of capabilities.chat-model. The side that creates the resource numbers it.
A handle of capabilities.memory. The side that creates the resource numbers it.
A handle of capabilities.tool. The side that creates the resource numbers it.
A handle of capabilities.embeddings. The side that creates the resource numbers it.

capabilities.chat-message.description: One message of a chat, oldest first.

finishReason.description: `stop`, `length`, `tool_calls`, `content_filter`, or a reason of the provider.

tools.description: Tools the model may call. A reply with tool calls has no final text.

output.description:
The reply text is JSON that matches this JSON Schema. The provider enforces it when
it can.

capabilities.tool-call.description: A tool call that a model asks for. `args` match the input schema of the tool.

id.description: The provider's call ID. A tool result names it.

capabilities.tool-definition.description: What a model reads about a tool.

name.description: Letters, digits, `_` and `-` only: providers refuse other names.

content.description: The tool result as text, usually JSON.

code.mode.description: `all`: one run that reads every input item. `each`: one run for each input item.

value.description: A cell value. None for `is-empty` and `is-not-empty`.

name.description: Tables whose name matches, without case.

count.description: All rows that the filter matches.

rows.description: Each row is an object: `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, and one field per column.

limit.description: The most rows of one page.

data-tables.table-info.description: A table without its rows. Dates are ISO 8601 text.

data-tables.table-ref.description: A table by its ID, or by its name in the project of the workflow.

response.description: The failed response, when a request caused the error.

oneOf.description: No response: DNS, connection, TLS, time-out, a host limit, or a refused host.

query.description: A repeated name sends each value: `id=a&id=b`.

retry.description:
None: the host retries a 429, 502, 503, 504 or a dropped connection for GET,
HEAD, PUT, or an action with `flow.idempotent`. True or false overrides this.

body.description: The JSON body, or the body text as a JSON string.

oneOf.description: An absolute http or https URL, for example a `next` link.
Starts with one `/` and goes after the base URL path. It cannot change the origin.

limits.run-limits.description:
The limits for one run: one input item, or all input items of a `batch` run. The host
enforces them.

parsers.csv-options.description: A CSV file. Each row is an object by column name, or a list of cells without `header`.

fromLine.description: The first line to read, from 1.

header.description: True when none: the first row names the columns.

includeEmptyCells.description: Keep an empty cell as an empty string in a row object.

relaxQuotes.description: Accept a quote in a cell that does not start with a quote.

bom.description: Remove a byte order mark at the start.

parsers.extract-request.description: The format to read the file as, with its options.

password.description: The password of an encrypted file.

parsers.sheet-options.description:
One sheet of an Excel 2007+ workbook. Each row is an object by column name, or a list
of cells without `header`.

range.description: An A1 range, e.g. `A2:D20`, or the row to start at, from 0.

header.description: True when none: the first row names the columns.

includeEmptyCells.description: Keep an empty cell as an empty string.

encoding.description: An iconv-lite encoding name. `utf8` when none.

stripBom.description: True when none: remove a byte order mark at the start.

type.description: The n8n credential type, for example `slackApi`.

fields.description: The declared fields that are not secret, as one object.
